kills.change_summary: Replace the credited amount so the deposit sets balance to msg.value instead of adding it.

kills.property: For any admissible input, after a Put, the stored unlock time is floored at the current block timestamp (Acc[actor].unlo
kills.change_summary: Remove the block.timestamp floor so an unlockTime in the past is stored instead of the current time.

kills.property: For every admissible input, a completed call to Put(v) appends a Log history entry recording exactly that deposit, so th
kills.change_summary: Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the log history.

kills.property: Every successful Put(v) must log exactly the deposited amount v as the message value; the mutant instead logs the caller
kills.change_summary: Log the caller's total balance instead of the deposited amount in AddMessage.

kills.property: For any deposit via Put, the log's History records a message with sender=depositor and Val=amount; deleting the LogFile.AddMessage call leaves History empty, breaking this for some deposit.
kills.change_summary: Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the log's History.

kills.property: For any deposit, the stored unlockTime must never be in the past: after Put(t), Acc[actor].unlockTime = max(t, block.timestamp) >= block.timestamp; the mutant stores t directly, so a past t yields unlockTime < block.timestamp.
kills.change_summary: Store _unlockTime directly instead of the maximum of _unlockTime and block.timestamp, allowing unlockTime to be set in the past.

kills.property: After Put(t) the stored unlockTime must equal max(t, block.timestamp), so a future t is stored exactly; the mutant stores block.timestamp instead, so any t strictly in the future breaks it.
kills.change_summary: Ignore the _unlockTime argument and always set unlockTime to block.timestamp.

kills.property: For any deposit, Put must store the holder's unlock time as max(_unlockTime, block.timestamp); the mutant never updates unlockTime, leaving it 0 and violating the rule whenever _unlockTime > block.timestamp.
kills.change_summary: Delete the unlockTime update so the stored unlock time is never modified by Put.
